name: Hysan Development Company Limited
summary: Hysan Development Company Limited is a leading property investment, management, and development company with a core portfolio of high-quality office, retail and residential space in Hong Kong. With roots in the city that go back more than 100 years, Hysan has focused on building the community, mixing the traditional and the new, applying technology and practicing sustainability. It has transformed the Lee Gardens area into a modern smart community, with a unique Hong Kong character, making it an attractive destination for leading multinational corporations, international visitors and residents.
